baseline_prompt_en: A practical woodworking-class photograph. An adult woodworking student stands at a wooden workbench, brushing dry wood shavings aside with a small hand brush. An unfinished wooden box remains on the same workbench. The camera is above the workbench, looking down onto its surface, with the student's head and shoulders entering along the near edge. The working hand grips the short brush handle; its forearm reaches forward from a relaxed elbow while the other hand rests on a clear part of the bench. A short stroke gathers curled shavings away from the box, exposing a strip of wood grain beside it. The student's patient concentration and poised movement give the working gesture a subtle human warmth. Diffuse workshop window light separates the pale curls, brushed area, and box joints. The frame explains both the class project and the small act of caring for its working space.
